subject: Operations
title: Regulatory Compliance Across Borders
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Regulatory Compliance Across Borders.

hook.text: A toy legal in the US is banned in Europe because of a chemical in the paint. Same product, different rules.

buildup.text: Every country has its own product safety, environmental, labeling, and import regulations that companies must follow.

discovery.text: Compliance costs include testing, certification, documentation, reformulation, and sometimes separate product versions.

twist.text: Non-compliance doesn't just mean fines—products can be seized at the border, destroyed, or trigger consumer lawsuits.

climax.text: The EU's CE marking, REACH regulations, and GDPR create a compliance web that every global operator must navigate.

punchline.text: Global products need local compliance. No exceptions.

quiz.question: What happens if products don't meet a country's regulations?
options: They can be seized or destroyed at the border
